target: Audio encoder prefix Conv1 -> GELU -> Conv2(1280->1280, K3, S2) -> GELU on the RK3588 NPU; same .rknn graph and tiling contract as v1
change: Persistent pre-allocated IO buffers; optional NPU core mask; optional concurrent tiles via rknn_dup_context bound to cores 0/1/2; optional single-pass FP16 input feed; first-request bitwise self-check against v1 settings with automatic fallback

integration.enable: OMNI_RKNN_AUDIO as before; v2 options OMNI_RKNN_PARALLEL_TILES, OMNI_RKNN_CORE_MASK, OMNI_RKNN_INPUT_FP16, OMNI_RKNN_SELFCHECK
integration.default: all v2 options unset -> v1 runtime behaviour (plus buffer reuse)

pre_board_checks.syntax: omni.cpp with the v2 adapter compiled with -fsyntax-only against MNN 7e3c6fb and rknn_api.h v2.3.2 (MNN_OMNI_RKNN_PREFIX)

limitations: Does not address the output-equivalence failure of the RKNN route versus the MNN OpenCL encoder (FP16 numerics differ by construction)
